sections.name: progress-and-messages
sections.prompt:
Create a production-quality Chinese RunBuoy marketing homepage section design reference, ONE independent image at 1600 x 1100. This is a below-the-fold section of the SAME homepage as attached reference 1, not a competing hero or app redesign. Maintain the approved style: luminous white with pale ice-blue ambient light, dark navy Chinese PingFang/SF-like typography, vivid blue emphasis, blue-purple CTA, restrained soft dimensional shadows, generous whitespace. Use the same red-white glossy friendly buoy mascot identity, black oval eyes, rosy cheeks, red antenna ball, blue water base. Mascot secondary rather than repeated dominant hero. Very subtle local water-ripple visual motifs rather than covering every section with water. No navigation or repeated hero slogan in these lower-page sections. Large legible text; section title 54-64px, body 26-28px, labels at least 22px. Remove decorative eyebrows and footnote microcopy. No '示例数据' or '新版预览' labels, no tiny legal/technical captions. No giant feature inventories, no nested decorative cards or generic SaaS card grid. Original app UI cards are valid and should be shown as prominent enlarged product evidence. Page headings and typography remain on the base page surface. Current date 2026-10-06; no invented future timestamps, prefer durations. Do not add unsupported features: RunBuoy reports computer task states/progress/messages, iPhone is read-only, ChatGPT plugin is private-preview and read-only. Output one polished layout screenshot, no montage, no explanatory annotations.
SECTION: Task progress and messages. Reference 2 is the REAL RunBuoy run detail UI; preserve its distinctive original blue task card, progress layout and messaging styling. Compose a spacious editorial section: top centered title two lines '任务分头跑，' and blue '进展一处看。', a single support line '几台电脑，各自工作。阶段、结果，一处掌握。'. Below at left, a large native task card from reference 2, near original screenshot proportions and all key data readable: '运行中', '大模型微调 · 第 8 轮', '工作室 Mac Studio', '训练第 8 / 10 个 Epoch', bold 78%, thick cyan blue progress bar, '7,800 / 10,000 steps', '已用时间 47:00', '最后确认 5 秒前'. Under it ONE actual message panel based on reference2, large title '训练第 8 / 10 个 Epoch' and concise text '验证集损失持续下降，预计约 7 分钟后完成。'. These are the two actual native product elements, no phone bezel or extra analytics.
At right aligned at card top, spacious simple typography '进展随手看，\n消息随身收。' then two plain text groups with subtle icons, no containers: '看阶段，也看结果' / '训练、构建、脚本，进展随时可查。'; '有消息，及时知晓' / '任务发来的重要消息，随身接收。'. A modest small buoy mascot near the lower-right area looking toward the task card, no face overlap, restrained pool reflection. At bottom a single blue text link '了解任务与进度 →'. Exclude extraneous meters, fake monitor/control buttons, feature taxonomy labels and extra small text. Keep all Chinese copy exact and visual task card faithful to source.

SECTION: Agent-first getting started plus compact privacy closing. Design a natural final scroll section of the homepage. Top centered strong title 'Agent 帮你装，' and blue 'RunBuoy 帮你看。', one readable support sentence '复制提示词，接入电脑。下次任务开始，状态随身带走。'. Under it a clean horizontal THREE-STEP journey on page surface, use small sequential numerals and simple blue icons, NO enclosing feature cards: '1 下载 App', '2 交给 Agent', '3 扫码配对'. Under each one short readable line respectively '在 iPhone 安装 RunBuoy', '复制提示词，完成安装与验证', '确认电脑，带走任务状态'. Thin connectors, clear hierarchy.

Below journey a single prominent large install action area around 950px wide, mild pale blue rounded background. Its left heading '让 Agent 完成安装' and one sentence '支持 Codex 等具备 Skill 能力的 Agent。'. Right a LARGE blue-purple gradient button with copy icon and exact label '复制安装提示词'. Below main action include collapsed text row '查看完整提示词 ⌄', then separate low-emphasis but readable row '手动安装与配对 ⌄'. Never display a huge code block or technical CLI commands in this marketing section. Agent install primary, manual secondary collapsed. App Store download is a secondary text link near step1, not competing giant CTA. No fake completion checkmarks because user hasn't installed.

Lower quarter separated by generous whitespace/light divider: concise privacy promise '电脑跑任务，手机看状态。' at 38px, then readable line '源码与完整日志，默认留在本机。' and text link '了解隐私 →'. A modest faithful red-white buoy mascot rests lower right in a small blue ripple pool, creating a final friendly brand signoff, not covering content. Base mostly white, pale blue footer fade. No extra footer sitemap, technical data-flow diagram, eyebrow copy, tiny warnings, '示例数据' or '新版预览'. This frame should feel dramatically simpler than a developer documentation page. Make all actions large and readable, typography clean and generous.
